title: Not everyone’s going to get it

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Let wording and community symbols work together because shared references can signal belonging without lengthy explanation.
strategic_value: A plainspoken line paired with changing emotes can give Twitch a knowing community voice.
demonstration: A short white sentence assembles on a black rounded card; different emotes appear at its end before the words leave.
practical_value: Compare the same sentence with different emote endings to judge how the visual reaction changes its tone.

content_islands.name: Message card
content_islands.spec: Center the black card on a pale ground with a short white sentence.

content_islands.name: Reaction ending
content_islands.spec: Append changing small emotes beside the final words, then animate the sentence away.

reference_purposes.Expression: The sentence and changing emote endings demonstrate an informal, knowing tone.
